collection.description: A child notices a prominent scar on an adult's arm and asks what happened.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) notices a prominent scar on (adult)'s arm and asks what happened.

choices.label: Answer Only What the Adult Wishes to Share

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (adult) offers a simple account and (child) is satisfied.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (adult) declines to explain, and (child) learns that privacy is allowed.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) practices asking before touching or questioning.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) realizes an unusual appearance is not an invitation to stare.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (child) learns that healed skin can look different.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) asks whether every scar has a dramatic story and learns that many do not.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The two return to weaving without awkwardness.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (adult) later chooses to share a funny memory associated with the scar.
